question: Who founded the Theosophical Society in New York in 1875?

options.text: Naoroji Furdunji and Satyendra Nath Bose
Baba Dayal Das and Madan Lal
Madame HP Blavatsky and Colonel Olcott

solution:
The correct answer is __**Madame HP Blavatsky and Colonel Olcott**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Theosophical Society was founded by **Madame Helena Petrovna Blavatsky** and **Colonel Henry Steel Olcott** in New York City in 1875.
 
• The society was created to advance the spiritual principles and search for the divine wisdom underlying all religions.
